snippet.title: Mouse Work - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The next great 'destroy your friendships' phenomenon is here. Tackle the chaos solo or bring a crew! Mouse Work launches Dec 7th on Switch 2.
👉 PRE-ORDER NOW ON THE NINTENDO eSHOP! - https://ain.pm/l/ACCs8A
(Search 'Mouse Work' on your Switch 2 to secure your copy today! 🐭❤️)

Mouse Work is the ultimate showcase for what the new Nintendo Switch 2 mouse controls can do. Dive into a deep 8-10+ hour single-player campaign to master the pixel-perfect mechanics, or plug in multiple mice for a totally original style of couch co-op. Combining precision cursor tracking, gyro, and tactile haptics, it’s a brand-new way to play together, or conquer entirely alone.

GAME FEATURES:
• SOLO CAMPAIGN OR 1–4 PLAYER CO-OP: Play through a meaty, full-length 10+ hour campaign entirely alone, or team up locally and online via GameShare to test the limits of your friendships.

• DYNAMIC LEVEL DESIGN: Stages and mechanics actively adapt to player count, ensuring solo runs and multiplayer sessions feel like completely distinct experiences.

• PUT THE JOY-CON™ 2 TO WORK: Finally, a game built for Nintendo Switch™ 2's mouse functionality, combining ultra-precise cursor control with expressive haptics and gyro controls.

• 54 JOBS ACROSS 18 UNIQUE ROLES: Tackle diverse careers including Climbing Instructor, Taxi Driver, Artist, Hairdresser, Gym Teacher, and IT Support.

• HUNT FOR HIDDEN CHEDDAR: Find secret stashes in every level, uncover hidden menu and title screen puzzles, and beat bonus challenges to unlock hundreds of cosmetics.

• THE ULTIMATE PARTY (AND SOLO) EXPERIENCE: Perfect for solo completionists looking for a deep challenge, or holiday gatherings that inevitably end in arguments.
So stop Mousin' Around! Pre-Order it today on the Nintendo Store and get ready for the launch on December 7th!

#MouseWork #NintendoSwitch2 #Nitrome #CoOpGames #SinglePlayer #Gaming #IndieGames
